messages:
jen (oncall): :rotating_light: Pager P1 - sudden rise in 401s and 5xxs hitting /v1/embeddings. WAF has started auto-blocks but users seeing failures. Can someone pick this up?

pagerduty-bot: Pager duty alert for service=embeddings-proxy severity=P1

mike (prodeng): Investigating. Telemetry shows auth token validation spikes and token-bucket drain on auth-proxy. A handful of ASNs account for most traffic — likely credential stuffing + scraper behavior.

olivia (sec): WAF rule 4127 firing heavily, approx 100k req/min blocked. I'll extract top offending IPs and UAs. Recommend immediate per-IP rate limit and geo-slice on suspicious ASNs.

sam (support): Support seeing ~15 customers reporting 429/502. One dedicated customer on reserved capacity is impacted — their SLA contact is pinged.

kevin (eng-runtime): Suggest emergency measures: 1) apply per-IP throttle to 8 req/s, 2) temporarily disable embeddings batch path to reduce server-side amplification, 3) enforce early auth short-circuit for malformed tokens.

jen (oncall): Do it. Mike/kevin apply throttles and push route disable. Sam draft a short customer notice. Olivia, push WAF export of top CIDRs.

mike (prodeng): Applying edge rule now.

```
# ops commands
edgectl apply-rate-slice --name "rapid-auth-probe" --scope ip --limit 8/s --duration 15m --reason "live mitigation: auth probe"
edgectl disable-route --route /v1/embeddings/batch --duration 10m --reason "mitigation"
```

pagerduty-bot: Edge rules applied: rapid-auth-probe rate slice active; embeddings batch route disabled.

kevin (eng-runtime): Confirmed: batch calls now 503. Inference node CPU utilization down ~30%, auth token queue length decreasing.

olivia (sec): Exporting WAF logs -> compiling top 40 IPs/ASNs and UA strings. I'll push ASN/geo blocks (initial: AS-45678 / CN-heavy IP blocks) and enable JS challenge on signin endpoints.

sam (support): Customer message ready:
"We're mitigating an automated traffic surge affecting embeddings. Temporary rate limits and a disabled batch endpoint may cause 429/503 responses. We're prioritizing customers on reserved capacity and will update in 15 minutes."

jen (oncall): Send to affected customers and post to status page as 'degraded'. Keep monitoring and report back.

mike (prodeng): Error rate decreased ~65% in 5 minutes. Keeping throttle for now and will reassess at 15m mark.

kevin (eng-runtime): Noted an internal fallback that bypassed quota headers — patched routing to respect edge quotas. Pushing a small fix.

olivia (sec): Captured payload patterns and UA markers. Will convert to WAF signatures and recommend CAPTCHA for login after incident.

sam (support): Notices dispatched and status updated.

jen (oncall): Plan: monitor 30m. If errors <10% and no new offender clusters, start a controlled rollback: re-enable batch endpoint with stricter quotas and keep per-IP slice.

mike (prodeng): Agreed. I'll shorten throttle if stable in 20m.

pagerduty-bot: Handoff scheduled to neo (night-oncall) at 3758004500

neo (night-oncall): Acknowledged. Monitoring takeover accepted.

olivia (sec): I'll prepare IOCs and a short triage doc for postmortem.

kevin (eng-runtime): Opening PM draft for post-incident timeline, mitigations, and follow-ups.

sam (support): Gathering impacted customer list for outreach and credits if needed.

jen (oncall): Ending active paging. Thread remains open for timeline notes and final impact numbers. :white_check_mark:
